headline: A 2022 law renames a Veterans Affairs outpatient clinic in Gaylord, Michigan, after Navy Corpsman Steve Andrews.
what_it_does: The law officially names the VA community-based outpatient clinic in Gaylord, Michigan, the Navy Corpsman Steve Andrews Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Clinic. It changes only the clinic's name and does not change its services, staffing, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on February 23, 2022.
